Package ecs_architecture.api

Interface DrawAPI

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    GameplayAPI
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    AnimationSystem, ClockSystem, ECSModel, EffectSystem, GameplayModel, GameSystem, RenderLayer, RenderLayerController, RenderRoutine, SpriteRenderSystem, TextSystem, TimerSystem
    Functional Interface:
    This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
    @FunctionalInterface
public interface DrawAPI
    A functional interface to be implemented when using a render layer to draw graphics

    • Method Detail

      • draw

        void draw​(java.lang.String spritesheet,
          double x,
          double y,
          int tile,
          int mirror,
          int scale,
          int alpha)
        Draws a sprite which is an 8x8 pixel image
        Parameters:
        spritesheet - the specified spritesheet to get the image from
        x - the specified x position to render the image
        y - the specified y position to render the image
        tile - the specified tile image on the spritesheet to render
        mirror - the specified direction to mirror the image
        scale - the specified scale to resize the image to
        alpha - the specified alpha value to apply to the image
